# participation event

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:participationEvent`](gmeow-participationEvent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/participationEvent>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The event a participation is part of (functional — one event per participation).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Participation`](../classes/gmeow-Participation.md) -> [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md); functional

    gmeow:participationRole gmeow:roleParticipantPrincipal .

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind a [`gmeow:Participation`](../classes/gmeow-Participation.md) to the single [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) it is about — the mandatory event player of the relator.

### Avoid when

- Avoid pointing it at a non-event, and avoid splitting one participation across two events — it is functional, so a participant in two events is two Participations.

### How to use

- Assert exactly one [`gmeow:participationEvent`](gmeow-participationEvent.md) per [`Participation`](../classes/gmeow-Participation.md) alongside [`gmeow:participationParticipant`](gmeow-participationParticipant.md); the SHACL closure shape checks both players are present.

- ex:p1 [`gmeow:participationEvent`](gmeow-participationEvent.md) ex:wedding.
